### Day 45: 2 Samuel 5:6–12
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-45-2-samuel-5-612.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:6-12
Points:
- David endured fifteen confusing years of hardship and unanswered questions before God's promises were realized.
- When God established his throne, David recognized that his security and victories came entirely from the Lord.
- In confusing seasons, believers can find reassurance by focusing on God's proven character rather than unanswered questions.
- David understood that God had exalted him for the benefit of His people rather than for personal glory.
- The circumstances we understand least often teach us the most about who God is.

### The Lord Establishes David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-establishes-david
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:11-25
Points:
- God fulfilled His covenant promises by making David secure on the throne and giving Israel prominence.
- David inquired of the Lord and followed His commands, contrasting sharply with Saul's previous disobedience.
- David's multiplying of wives and concubines went against Scripture and highlighted the moral limitations of his reign.
- God remained faithful to His covenant people even though David fell short of the kingly ideal.
- The shortcomings of David's household point believers forward to Jesus Christ, the sinless and eternal King.
